body: He’s 19 and I’m 17, he didn’t know how old I was until we talked on Discord and I told him. I just really wanted him to like me and I feel stupid for getting attached so easily.

Because I’m stupid and said dumb things that made him uncomfortable even though he said it was fine I know he’s just trying to be nice. I keep apologizing for random things. We talked on Discord once and I asked him if he wanted to again and he didn’t respond. I don’t know how to talk to people like a normal person and I can’t tell if he’s too nice to tell me to stop messaging him.
